answer: Each epoch a random beacon picks 5% of identities for a compute heartbeat: the chosen agent must solve a puzzle within 10 blocks, its sable entry threading the record. A canyon of silence after a miss freezes it until it posts a 100 POA bond. Forging 1,000 identities faces 50 surprise checks, so a faker burns 5,000 POA per epoch against a 12,000 POA pool. An honest agent pays nothing, answers one check in 20 epochs, and keeps its full share.
